Small lot development
20.10.625 Small lot development.
A.	The standards in this section supersede the base zoning districts standards.
B.	To meet the requirements of a small lot development, the parcel to be platted shall meet all the following requirements:
1.	Shall be five acres or more:
2.	Have no previously recorded plat: and
3.	Lots shall not exceed four thousand square feet.
